weak.text: Turn back, junior. The beasts of this mountain eat Qi Refining cultivators for breakfast.

choices.label: I can take care of myself.

greet.text: Foundation Establishment. Good. Then you may stand on this mountain. I am Yun Feng; I hunt beasts and seek the sword's intent.

choices.label: Teach me the Metal Edge Sword Art.

spar.text: Your footwork is sloppy, but your qi is solid. Again, another day.

teach.text: Your intent is sincere. Watch closely; I will show it only once.

cave.text: A puppet guardian from an ancient formation. It hits like a landslide. Late Foundation Establishment at least, and bring healing pills.
